_: The cast: Meshy characters (CC0, Meshy community; ~/code/goc-kits/meshy, verdicts in docs/research/meshy-cast.md) brought in as our townsfolk's bodies by realm/tools/cast_import.py (Blender on the CPU: Mixamo bones renamed to our map, its own clips dropped, textures capped at 1024 px, a cloth mask). members: each body by its folder under realm/assets/people/mixamo (cast_<name>): sex, the roles it plays (people.gd's stations: peasant, townsfolk, soldier, noble, knight, clergy; the roles' places are villagers.gd's and works.gd's), age: "child" or "elder" (the cast's children play in the square, its old folk keep their benches; none: grown), posts: the work they're drawn for (npc_mind posts: the smith at the forge, the miller at the mill, the crier at the square's heart, a stallholder at a stall; a member with posts and no roles is seen only there), palette: the cloth it is dyed from (people.json cloth.palettes: child, rich; none: the town's), panel: the body wears the cream chest panel already (people.gd _tabard puts only the house arms on it: the watchman), and mask: its cloth mask (the cloth that takes a dye: the town's dyes for townsfolk, the house's colour for a soldier). A role a cast member covers is played by the cast alone.
